sloka: राक्षसानाम् अयम् वासः कथम् तु त्वम् इह आगता ।इह शाखामृगाः सिंहा द्वीपि व्याघ्र मृगाः तथा ॥३-४६-२९॥
transliteration: rākṣasānām ayam vāsaḥ katham tu tvam iha āgatā ।iha śākhāmṛgāḥ siṁhā dvīpi vyāghra mṛgāḥ tathā ॥3-46-29॥

translations.english: There are monkeys, lions, panthers, tigers, hyenas, bears, kanka birds and other wild animals here. How is it that you are not afraid of them?
